references.text: Here too Peter confesses Jesus as the Christ, which shows a parallel in the understanding of Jesus' identity.
Peter confesses that Jesus is the Holy One of God, which points to his understanding of Jesus' divine nature.
Peter confesses Jesus as the Christ, the Son of the living God, which is a direct parallel to the confession in Mark.
Peter confesses that Jesus is God's chosen one, which is another formulation of faith in Jesus as the Messiah.
